author: blu
body: Proves dies (OnDeath) triggers. A creature whose Oracle text says "When ~ dies, <effect>" compiles to a TriggeredAbility on OnDeath; the engine fires it in destroy-permanent while the creature is still on the battlefield, then moves it to the graveyard. Death Cultist draws a card as it dies; Bane Imp deals two damage to the opponent's creature as it dies, and the resulting lethal is caught by the state-based-action sweep. Both abilities come from parse-creature-abilities, so real dies cards are modelled.
